et.title: Booking ja Rent Workspace v2-s
et.description: Booking haldab teenuseid, nädalast saadavust, asukohti ja Website’i päringuid. Rent haldab kirjeid, ressursse, rendiperioode ja taotlusi. Mõlemad on Website’iga seotud paketipõhised töövood.
et.keywords: Extaas Workspace Booking, Rent, broneerimine, rentimine, päringud, kliendihaldus

en.title: Booking and Rent in Workspace v2
en.description: Booking manages services, weekly availability, locations and Website requests. Rent manages listings, resources, rental periods and requests. Both are package-owned workflows attached to Website.
en.keywords: Extaas Workspace Booking, Rent, booking, rental, requests, customer management
